description: This is a Java test class for the ContactsDictionary component in an Android application, utilizing Robolectric for unit testing. It tests contact data loading, observer registration/unregistration, and word validation functionalities.

classes.name: ContactsDictionaryTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the ContactsDictionary component, including contact loading, observer registration, and word validation.

classes.name: ContactsDictionary
classes.description: Main class under test, representing a dictionary built from contacts.

classes.name: ContactsDictionary.ContactsContentProvider
classes.description: A mock content provider for contacts used in testing.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, sets up mock contacts, and loads the dictionary.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Cleans up after tests, shutting down the mock provider.

methods.name: setAllowContactsRead
methods.description: Mocks permission granting or denial for reading contacts.

methods.name: testFailsToLoadIfNoPermission
methods.description: Verifies that loading the dictionary without permission throws an exception.

methods.name: testRegisterObserver
methods.description: Tests that content observers are registered and notified upon contact updates.

methods.name: testCloseUnregisterObserver
methods.description: Ensures observers are unregistered when the dictionary is closed.

methods.name: testDeleteWordFromStorageDoesNotHaveEffect
methods.description: Checks that deleting a word from storage does not affect its validity.

methods.name: testAddWordToStorageDoesNotHaveEffect
methods.description: Checks that adding a word to storage does not make it valid.

methods.name: testIsValid
methods.description: Verifies the validity of known contact names.

methods.name: testGetNextWords
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of next words based on contact names.
